title: Deviations from Spacelift
description: Every place infraweave departs from Spacelift on purpose, each a design commitment of an Accepted decision record. docs/implementation/deviations.md says what counts as a deviation and how to add one.

id.description: DV-NNN, numbered across the register and never reused.

group.description: The subject and the decisions that own it. Each group is a heading of the Register section of docs/implementation/deviations.md, so its anchor there is the heading's slug.
enum: Runs, workers and policies: decisions 0008 and 0009

spacelift.description: What Spacelift does, as a report records it. A behaviour the reports mark *(unverified)* says so.

infraweave.description: What infraweave does instead, with the exact names of settings, routes and fields.

why.description: The limit avoided or the property gained.

impact.description: None, with the reason, or what a Spacelift client, an operator or a script must change.

source.description: The decision record, linked to the section that names the departure.

pending.description: Present while the record rests on Spacelift behaviour that a capture of report 30 has not yet shown. When the capture lands, the record stays, changes or is withdrawn with its decision.

settles.description: What the captures settle for this record.

withdrawn.description: Present on a record that no longer holds: why, and the decision that withdrew it. The ID stays reserved.
